transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
Um… I guess I came in because I’ve been having thoughts that maybe my family would be better off if I didn’t wake up. That scared me enough that I told my supervisor.
Are you wanting to kill yourself right now?
I… I don’t know that I want to kill myself right now. It’s more that I keep thinking maybe they’d be better off if I just didn’t wake up. That’s what scared me.
Right now, do you intend to kill yourself?
I don’t… I don’t think I intend to do it right now. It’s more those thoughts about not waking up, like my family might be better off. That’s what scared me.
Did these thoughts start after something stressful happened in your life?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been about two weeks, since my daughter left Georgia for the military. That’s when this whole… change in me started.
Since your daughter left, have you been feeling down or depressed most days?
I don’t know… maybe. I haven’t really been keeping track like that. It’s just been… heavier than usual, I guess.
Since your daughter left, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I guess I have. I used to mess with my tomato plants, sand wood out at my bench, watch the Falcons, stay after church talking a bit. Lately I just kind of look at all that like it belongs to somebody else.
Do these feelings mostly come up when you’re thinking about your daughter being away?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I do think about her, yeah. But I can’t say it’s only then. It just kind of sits there.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed nearly every day?
I… I don’t know about nearly every day. Some days feel pretty low, but I haven’t really been counting it like that.
Do you spend a lot of time longing for or preoccupied with your daughter since she left?
I don’t know… I think about her some, sure. But “a lot of time,” I’m not really sure how to answer that.
Even when you’re not thinking about your daughter, do you still feel down?
Yeah… I’m not sure. Sometimes I feel off even when I’m not really thinking about her, but I haven’t paid close attention to it.
Have these feelings been making it hard for you to function at work or at home?

Yeah… it has. Work’s been… not good. I made some mistakes, enough that my supervisor found me sitting in my truck before dawn and got occupational health involved.

At home, I’ve been letting bills and stuff pile up. Things I’d normally just handle, I just… haven’t.
For the past two weeks, have you felt down or depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t know if I’d say nearly every day. I’ve felt down a lot, yeah… but I haven’t really been tracking it like that.
Since this started, have you been waking up much earlier than usual and not able to get back to sleep?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed that specifically. My sleep hasn’t been something I’ve kept close track of.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt sad or empty most of the day?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had some low stretches, but saying most of the day… I don’t know. I haven’t been measuring it like that.
Since this started, have you noticed your appetite being lower than usual?
Yeah… I guess it has been lower. Most days I kind of have to make myself eat a few bites. Stuff I usually like just sits there, at work or at home, and I end up tossing it.
Since this started, have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy?
I’m not sure. I mean… I get worn out, but I don’t know if it’s more than usual. I haven’t really paid attention to it like that.
Since this started, have you been feeling like a burden to your family?
Yeah… I guess that’s part of it. I’ve been having thoughts like… maybe my family would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. That scared me enough that I told my supervisor and came in.
Since this started, have you been feeling hopeless?
I don’t know… hopeless sounds strong. I’ve had some pretty dark thoughts, but I’m not sure I’d put that word on it.
Since this started, have you been feeling worthless?
Yeah… maybe. I keep thinking about my daughter leaving, and I end up telling myself I must’ve failed her somehow. Like if I’d been a better father, maybe I would’ve done something different.
Before your daughter left, have you ever had another period like this in your life?
Yeah… I think so. Looking back, I’ve had some low stretches off and on for maybe the past year. But this time, after my daughter left… it’s been the worst one.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a current depressive episode characterized by passive suicidal ideation, anhedonia, decreased appetite, guilt/worthlessness, and functional impairment. Although he is uncertain about depressed mood frequency, the syndrome is most consistent with a depressive episode. Adjustment disorder was considered because symptoms worsened after his daughter left, but the presence of a broader depressive symptom cluster with suicidal thoughts and a history of prior low episodes makes a depressive disorder more likely. Recurrent depressive disorder remains a differential because of prior low stretches over the past year, but prior episodes were not clearly characterized enough to confirm recurrence.
